languages.cs.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# build one C# file the way the lessons do: inside the image's restored project
set -e
rm -rf /tmp/cs && cp -r /opt/templates/csharp /tmp/cs && cp "$1" /tmp/cs/Program.cs
cd /tmp/cs && dotnet build --no-restore -v q -nologo -clp:NoSummary
dotnet bin/Debug/net10.0/Program.dll
languages.mix.go:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	count := 3
	price := 2.5
	total := count * price
	fmt.Println(total)
}
languages.reassign.go:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	count := 0
	count += 1 // fine: variables are mutable unless declared `const`
	const fixed = 0
	fixed += 1
	fmt.Println(count)
}
languages.reassign.py:

count += 1
print(count)
count = "now a string"  # nothing stops a name from being rebound
print(count)

ready = True
if ready:
    port = 8080
print(f"listening on {port}")

ready = False
del port
if ready:
    port = 8080
print(f"listening on {port}")
